newsitem.title: JAPAN: Qatar cuts Feb crude formulas by 5 to 6 cts/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Qatar cuts Feb crude formulas by 5 to 6 cts/bbl.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) cut its price formula for February-lifting Qatar Land crude by five cents per barrel and that of Qatar Marine by six cents per barrel, traders here said on Wednesday.

According to the QGPC formula, February Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 61 cents per barrel, which translated into $20.33 per barrel, and February Qatar Marine at Oman plus 53 cents per barrel, or $20.25 per barrel.
January Qatar Land was set at Oman plus 66 cents per barrel, or $23.16 per barrel, and January Qatar Marine at Oman plus 59 cents, or $23.09.
Qatar's retroactive price formula is based on the official selling price of Oman crude issued monthly by Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Mines.
